title: Không, cảm ơn
summary: A polite refusal for vendors, offers, and small service choices.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Không, cảm ơn closes a helpful exchange warmly. It is short enough for a beginner and works after directions, service help, a purchase, or a small kindness.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say Không, cảm ơn when the answer is no but you want the interaction to stay friendly.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Read the cards left to right: first catch the request shape, then the place, item, action, or time detail, and finally the complete phrase.

sections.title: Nearby refusals
sections.body: Use these when the refusal needs more context.

phrases.english: No thank you, I’m not interested
phrases.pronunciation: Khong cam on toi khong quan tam

phrases.vietnamese: Không, cảm ơn, tôi sẽ xem xét xung quanh trước
phrases.english: No thank you, I’ll look around first
phrases.pronunciation: Khong cam on toi se xem xet xung quanh truoc

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this in a real polite basics exchange when no, thank you is the detail you need resolved. The likely reply is a smile, acknowledgment, or short reply, so keep the phrase short and ready for one follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A calm tone matters as much as the words. Short polite phrases keep the exchange warm without forcing a long conversation.
